item.content: {"url": "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=cognitive+reasoning+agents+autonomous+safety+incident+analysis+industrial+domains&format=json&resultType=core&pageSize=4", "scope": "Europe PMC search metadata, abstracts and full-text links; discovery only", "excerpt": "[{\"title\": \"Bridging Cognitive Architecture and Developmental Measurement for Artificial General Intelligence.\", \"abstract\": \"Current artificial intelligence evaluation often relies on static benchmarks and task-specific performance metrics, which are useful for system comparison but limited in assessing developmental progression, cognitive architecture, adaptive transfer, and real-world applicability. Building on developmental approaches to AGI testing, including our earlier conceptual proposal, this article develops an operational formulation of the General-Specialized-Applicable (GSA) framework for artificial general intelligence (AGI) evaluation. The framework organizes evidence into three non-interchangeable stages: the General stage, which assesses foundational capacities for open-ended generalization, value-oriented regulation, and autonomy; the Specialized stage, which evaluates stable domain-specific competence; and the Applicable stage, which examines whether such competence can be deployed safely and robustly in realistic environments. The article further introduces a dynamic task-generation pipeline and a provisional operational rubric for interpreting stage-specific evidence. An illustrative case study using household tasks in a simulated embodied environment illustrates how GSA can provide diagnostic information beyond aggregate benchmark scores by identifying capability gaps in current multimodal large language model (MLLM) agents. Rather than offering a final universal standard, the GSA framework provides an evaluation-oriented structure for connecting benchmark performance with architectural readiness, specialization, and deployment-level applicability.\", \"doi\": \"10.3390/jintelligence14080179\", \"pmid\": \"42646025\", \"pmcid\": \"PMC13514576\", \"source\": \"MED\", \"fullTextUrlList\": {\"fullTextUrl\": [{\"availability\": \"Subscription required\", \"availabilityCode\": \"S\", \"documentStyle\": \"doi\", \"site\": \"DOI\", \"url\": \"https://doi.org/10.3390/jintelligence14080179\"}, {\"availability\": \"Open access\", \"availabilityCode\": \…
